build_FrozenInTime_model: build a FrozenInTime model with video and text params for EgoVLPv2 video-language pretraining on EPIC-KITCHENS or Charades datasets
run_infer_method: run the infer method on video and text data to compute embeddings for Dual, ITM, or MLM tasks
compute_sim_matrix: compute the cosine similarity matrix between text and video embeddings using the sim_matrix function
compute_sim_matrix_batch: compute batched cosine similarity matrices for validation using sim_matrix_batch_val with 3D tensor inputs
review_FrozenInTime_forward: review the FrozenInTime forward pass that handles Dual contrastive learning with allgather across GPUs for EPIC and Charades datasets
